name: Texas Braised Roast
ingredients: 3-4 lb - lamb or beef meat (if beef, use brisket, flank or other tough cut of beef)
1 - thinly sliced medium to large onion
1 cup - Dry Red Wine (more use for frozen leftover wine!)
instructions: Prepare the pan: Select a casserole or roasting pan with a lid that just fits the size of meat you are cooking. If it doesn’t seal well, line the pan with tin foil and seal the foil around the meat.

Cook: Put all ingredients in casserole dish, cover with tight fitting lid or seal with tin foil. Bake for 3-4 hours or until meat is very tender. It could take longer depending on the size of the meat. After 2 hours, check there is still lots of liquid in the cooking dish.
Testing for tender: Stab meat with a fork, it should slide in and out. It will ‘stick’ if the meat is not tender enough.
Serve: Cover meat and keep warm in a low oven. Strain sauce. Make a gravy with the sauce by whisking in a tablespoon of flour or cornstarch mixed with a tablespoon of water

additional_context.source: Adapted from Jewish Cooking in America recipe for beef brisket. Serve sliced or shred with forks for a pulled version on buns.
additional_context.tips: Suggested sides: Great as a main dish with rice or potatoes. Or you can ‘pull’ the meat apart and add the gravy or some BBQ sauce and serve on buns.
